## Added

- **English / French toggle** in Settings — switches every user-facing string app-wide (menu bar, dropdown, Settings, error messages), defaults to English.
- **Estimated billing cycle** shown below the usage bar in the dropdown — Anthropic's usage API doesn't expose real billing-period dates, so this is a plainly-labeled calendar-month approximation.
- **VoiceOver labels** on the menu bar item and refresh button — previously the app's core readout had no accessible name at all.
- **Motion**: usage numbers roll instead of snapping on refresh, the progress bar eases to its new width, dropdown states crossfade. Respects Reduce Motion throughout.
- **Custom brand mark** (light/dark SVG) replacing the generic `cpu` SF Symbol in the dropdown header.
- Issue templates (bug report / feature request forms) and a real MIT `LICENSE` file (was referenced by name only before).

## Changed

- **Menu bar icon redesigned**: now shows `<percent>% • $<amount>` as colored text instead of a filled progress bar — the percentage itself carries the status color (green / orange / red), no separate fill.
- Settings window title now follows the selected language (was hardcoded to French regardless of setting).
- README rewritten to match the current app and installation flow.

## Fixed

- Error text contrast (magenta) in dark mode — was under the WCAG AA threshold.
- Manual token field in Settings no longer writes to the Keychain on every keystroke (debounced).
- 401/403 API responses now show an actionable "token invalid or expired" message instead of a raw status code.
- Xcode warning: dead nil-coalescing on a non-optional `DateIntervalFormatter` result.

## Known limitations

- The billing cycle range is a calendar-month estimate, not Anthropic's actual billing period — there is no API field for it.
- No custom `.icns`/app icon in the build yet — the app and `.dmg` still use the default generic icon (the brand SVGs exist but aren't wired into codesign/dmg packaging).
- Not notarized (no Apple Developer Program account) — first launch needs a right-click → Open, or `xattr -cr`.
- No OAuth refresh-token flow: when the Claude Code token expires, re-run `claude login` or paste a fresh token in Settings.
